name: mobile-jank
description: Area-4 mobile UI/UX audit (2026-09-19): the two phone gestures whose smoothness the review brief calls out — dragging the catalog bottom sheet, and steering with the walk-mode joystick. Recorded with scripts/dev-probes/sweep/record.mjs --arm phone-metal (390x844, DPR 3, touch, deviceClass weak) and triaged with analyse.mjs for dropped/duplicate frames.

clips.name: mobile-catalog-sheet-drag
clips.note: Open the catalog bottom sheet in the Living/Dining room editor, flick the card grid up, then drag the sheet back down by its grabber.

clips.name: mobile-walk-joystick
clips.note: Hold the bottom-left walk joystick (88x88 at 20,732) forward, swing it around the ring, then release.
